name: Lightfall-TS-TW
title: Lightfall
description: A violet-blue backdrop of curved white streaks falling from a bright patch at the top centre, like light through a tunnel. The streaks shift and twinkle while the whole scene flows slowly outward.
use: A launch page or banner needs a full-bleed dramatic backdrop with motion but no content.
avoid: Pages with lots of text on top: the busy streaks and bright core lower contrast everywhere.
a11y: Decorative shader only. It has no motion preference check, so the continuous animation always runs. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A deep violet-to-navy gradient fills the frame, brightest at the top middle where a soft blue-white glow sits. Hundreds of thin pale streaks run down and fan outward in curved lines, denser near the edges.
behaves: Streaks fall and curve away from the centre, with parallel trails sliding at different lengths so the pattern churns. Some flicker in brightness; the pointer adds a faint tinted glow wherever it rests.
customise: Streak count, width, length, palette, background colour, speed, glow, density, twinkle and zoom are props. Changing the tunnel shape means editing the shader.
weight: heavy: A full-screen fragment shader with a per-pixel ray loop runs every frame.
polishWhy: Depth and motion read well; the bright core washes out the top of the frame.
